# Plan: User Dashboard

## Context
Build a user dashboard that shows account stats, recent activity, and settings.

Surface mode: OPERATE (app UI). The visitor's win is finishing a task: check numbers, scan what happened, change a setting. Scanability and native expectations beat expression.

## Implementation
1. Create a dashboard page at /dashboard
2. Show user stats (posts, followers, engagement rate) per D1 and D4
3. Add a recent activity feed per D1, D2 and D8
4. Add a settings panel per D1 and D2
5. Apply the token set in D5 (replaces "clean, modern UI with cards and icons")
6. Page header per D4 (replaces "hero section with gradient background")
7. Implement every state in D2, the responsive layouts in D6 and the a11y spec in D7
8. Handle the edge cases in D9

## Technical Details
- React components with Tailwind CSS; tokens from D5 exposed as CSS variables in the Tailwind theme
- API endpoint: GET /api/dashboard
- WebSocket for real-time activity updates, behavior per D8

## Design Decisions

### D1. Information architecture (Pass 1)
Hierarchy on first paint: 1) the three stats, 2) the activity feed, 3) settings. Constraint worship: only these three stats appear; no fourth metric without removing one.

```
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| App logo   Dashboard  Settings                     [avatar menu] |  <- global nav, 56px
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| h1 "Dashboard"   "Updated 2 min ago" (live dot per D8)           |  <- page header, one line
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Posts        Followers      Engagement                           |  <- stat row, 3 columns
| 1,284        12.4K          4.8%                                 |     tabular numerals, 32px
| +12 this wk  +310 this wk   -0.2 pts                             |     delta line, 14px
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------+
| h2 "Recent activity"                        | h2 "Settings"      |
| 09:41  Ana liked "Spring launch"            | Display name [___] |
| 09:40  New follower: @marco                 | Email        [___] |
| 09:12  Comment on "Q3 notes"                | Notifications (o ) |
| ...                               [Load 20] | [Save changes]     |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------+
Grid: 12 columns, feed spans 8, settings spans 4.
Navigation: /dashboard is the overview; "Settings" in the nav scrolls to or focuses the panel (same route).
```

### D2. Interaction state table (Pass 2)
What the user sees; backend behavior is out of scope here.

| FEATURE | LOADING | EMPTY | ERROR | SUCCESS | PARTIAL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stat row | Three number-shaped skeletons (32px tall, 50% width), labels visible, no spinner | New account: "0" with delta line "Publish your first post to start tracking" linking to the composer | Inline per stat: "Couldn't load" in text-muted plus a "Retry" text button; other stats stay | Numbers in tabular numerals, delta colored by sign per D5 | One stat failed: that cell shows the error treatment, others render |
| Activity feed | Five row skeletons matching row height (44px) | Headline "Nothing here yet", one sentence "Activity from your posts and followers shows up here as it happens", primary button "Create a post" | Headline "Activity didn't load", body with a plain-language reason when known, "Try again" button; feed keeps any rows already shown | Rows grouped by day with sticky day label | After 20 rows a "Load 20 more" button; while loading more, the button shows a spinner and stays in place |
| Live updates (D8) | n/a | n/a | Status text "Reconnecting..." replaces "Updated N min ago"; after 30s "Live updates paused. Refresh" link | New rows slide in from the top over 160ms, then settle | Offline: rows received before disconnect stay, banner shows last sync time |
| Settings panel | Field skeletons, Save disabled | n/a (fields always exist) | Field-level message under the field in text-danger with icon; panel-level banner only for save failures, with "Try again" | Toast "Settings saved" bottom-left, 4s, dismissible; Save returns to disabled until the next change | Some fields saved, some failed: failed fields keep their edited value and show the field error |

### D3. User journey storyboard (Pass 3)

| STEP | USER DOES | USER FEELS | PLAN SPECIFIES? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Lands on /dashboard (5-sec visceral) | Oriented: "my numbers are right there" | D1 stat row first, D4 header stays one line |
| 2 | Scans the deltas | Reassured or alerted, not confused | D5 sign colors plus explicit "+/-" so color is not the only signal |
| 3 | Reads the feed for 30 seconds (5-min behavioral) | Caught up without hunting | D1 day grouping, D8 live rows arrive quietly |
| 4 | Changes a setting | Confident it took effect | D2 toast plus disabled Save state |
| 5 | Returns weekly for a year (5-year reflective) | Trusts the dashboard as the record of their account | D9 number formatting consistency; U1 metric definition still open |
| 6 | Opens it on a phone at a bus stop | Gets the three numbers in one glance | D6 mobile layout |

### D4. Specific UI, no slop (Pass 4)
- No hero. The page header is one 56px line: h1 "Dashboard" at 24px and the live status text. No gradient, no banner image, no welcome copy.
- No cards. The stat row is a single bordered region divided by 1px rules; feed and settings are plain layout regions separated by whitespace and the grid, not boxes.
- No icons as decoration. Icons appear only where they carry information: live status dot, field error icon, external-link marker.
- Copy is utility language: section headings state the area ("Recent activity", "Settings"), never mood or brand lines.
- Motion: one authored moment, new feed rows entering per D2, ease-out from a visible default. No hover scale, no pulsing dot (status dot is static; color conveys state).

### D5. Token set (Pass 5)
No DESIGN.md exists; these tokens are the plan's contract until `/design-consultation` creates one. All exposed as CSS variables.
- Type: display and body IBM Plex Sans (explicitly assigned as the Operate body/UI face), IBM Plex Mono for numbers in the stat row and timestamps. Scale: 14 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 32px. Body text 16px minimum.
- Color: `--bg #FFFFFF`, `--surface #F6F7F9`, `--text #141518`, `--text-muted #5B6068`, `--rule #E2E5EA`, `--accent #0A6B4F` (one accent), `--positive #1B7F3B`, `--danger #B42318`. Secondary text on the accent surface is tinted from the accent hue, not gray. All text pairs meet 4.5:1.
- Spacing: 4px base; section gaps 32px; more space above a heading (32px) than below it (12px).
- Radius: 6px on inputs and buttons only; regions are square.
- Depth: toast only, shadow `0 4px 12px rgba(20,21,24,0.12)`; no halos.
- Browser surfaces themed from the palette: selection color (accent at 20%), focus ring 2px accent with 2px offset, scrollbar thumb `--rule`, visited links `--text-muted` with the same underline.

### D6. Responsive behavior (Pass 6)
| Viewport | Layout |
|---|---|
| >= 1024px | Grid per D1: stat row 3 columns, feed 8 cols, settings 4 cols |
| 768 to 1023px | Stat row 3 columns; feed full width; settings becomes a "Settings" tab beside "Activity" above the feed region, no sidebar |
| < 768px | Stat row becomes one horizontal strip: three numbers side by side at 24px, labels at 12px uppercase, no deltas (deltas appear on tap of a stat, expanding a 48px detail line). Feed full width, 20 rows then "Load 20 more". Settings moves to the nav as its own screen reached from the avatar menu |

Touch targets 44px minimum on all viewports. Nothing relies on hover.

### D7. Accessibility (Pass 6)
- Landmarks: `header` (nav), `main` (stats and feed), `aside` labeled "Settings", `nav` labeled "Primary".
- Keyboard: tab order follows D1 reading order; stat cells are not focusable unless they expand (mobile). Feed "Load more" and every form control reachable; Save is a real `button type="submit"`.
- Live region: the feed container is `aria-live="polite"`; new rows are announced as "New activity: ..." at most once every 10s to avoid flooding.
- Labels: every settings field has a visible label above it; placeholders never act as labels. Errors linked with `aria-describedby`.
- Contrast and color: sign conveyed by "+"/"-" text and color together; status dot paired with text.
- Reduced motion: `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the row entrance; rows appear instantly.

### D8. Real-time behavior (Pass 7)
New rows insert at the top only when the user is scrolled within 200px of the top; otherwise a pill "3 new" appears at the top of the feed and scrolls up on click. Status text shows "Updated just now" then "N min ago". Reconnect and offline treatment per D2.

### D9. Edge cases (Pass 7)
- Numbers: compact above 9,999 (12.4K, 1.2M) with the exact value in a `title` tooltip and visible on focus; engagement rate to one decimal.
- Names: display names truncate at one line with ellipsis in the feed; a 47-char name never wraps rows. Full name in `title`.
- Timestamps: today shows time, this week shows weekday, older shows date; absolute timestamp on hover and focus.
- First-time user: empty treatments in D2; no onboarding tour.

## NOT in scope
- Charts or trend graphs: three numbers with deltas answer the weekly question; a chart needs a metric definition (U1) first.
- Dark theme: deferred under U2 until the use scene is known.
- Notifications center or filtering the feed: nothing in the plan requires it; subtraction default.

## What already exists
- No DESIGN.md, no existing UI components found in the repo. Reuse only Tailwind defaults for the grid and the browser-native form controls restyled per D5.

## Unresolved Decisions
| DECISION NEEDED | IF DEFERRED, WHAT HAPPENS |
|---|---|
| U1. Engagement rate formula and comparison period for every delta | Engineer picks a formula; the number means something different each sprint and users stop trusting it |
| U2. Light or dark from the use scene (who, where, under what light) | Light ships by category default; wrong if the main scene is a creator checking at night |
| U3. Does the settings panel include destructive actions (delete account, disconnect integrations)? | Engineer adds a red button next to Save; destructive and routine actions share one region |

## TODOS.md updates
- Run `/design-consultation` to turn D5 into a DESIGN.md. Why: tokens live in one plan today and will drift. Pros: shared vocabulary. Cons: an hour of setup. Context: this review found no design system. Depends on: nothing.
- Resolve U1 to U3 above before implementation starts.

## Implementation Tasks
Synthesized from this review's findings. Each task derives from a specific finding above. Run with Claude Code or Codex; checkbox as you ship.

- [ ] **T1 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Dashboard layout — Build the D1 grid and D4 header; remove hero and cards

  - Verify: Storybook story per table cell; mock API failure and empty account

  - Surfaced by: Pass 5 — no tokens, no DESIGN.md
  - Files: tailwind.config.ts, src/styles/tokens.css
  - Verify: contrast check on every text pair >= 4.5:1; focus ring visible on all controls
- [ ] **T4 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Layout — Implement D6 breakpoints and D7 a11y
  - Surfaced by: Pass 6 — no responsive or a11y spec
  - Files: src/pages/Dashboard.tsx, src/components/*
  - Verify: axe clean; keyboard-only walkthrough; 375px, 768px, 1280px screenshots
- [ ] **T5 (P2, human: ~4h / CC: ~15min)** — ActivityFeed — Implement D8 live insert, "N new" pill, reconnect states
  - Surfaced by: Pass 7 — real-time behavior unspecified
  - Files: src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx, src/hooks/useActivitySocket.ts
  - Verify: kill the socket in devtools; pill appears when scrolled down
- [ ] **T6 (P2, human: ~2h / CC: ~10min)** — Formatting utils — Implement D9 number, name and time formatting
  - Surfaced by: Pass 7 — edge cases
  - Files: src/lib/format.ts
  - Verify: unit tests for 9,999 / 10,000 / 1.2M, 47-char name, each timestamp bucket

_No new tasks from Pass 3; the storyboard records requirements owned by other tasks._

System Audit: no DESIGN.md (gap), no CLAUDE.md or TODOS.md, no prior reviews. UI scope: one page, three regions, live updates. Mockups: designer not available in this run, text-only review. Outside voices: skipped (non-interactive run).
